fields.description: When enabled, an inbound SMS from a number that does not match any existing Contact, Lead, or Deal will automatically create a new CRM Lead.
fields.label: Auto Create Leads for Unknown Numbers

fields.description: The Twilio number SMS is sent from, in E.164 format (e.g. +15551234567). Not required if Messaging Service SID is set. Uses the Account SID/Auth Token from CRM Twilio Settings.
fields.label: Sender Phone Number

fields.description: Optional. If set, outbound messages are sent via this Messaging Service instead of the Sender Phone Number directly.
fields.label: Messaging Service SID

fields.description: Explicit public HTTPS base URL Twilio should sign requests against (e.g. https://crm.example.com). Only needed if this site sits behind a proxy/load balancer where the auto-detected site URL would not match what Twilio computed the request signature for.
fields.label: Webhook URL Override

fields.description: Sent automatically in reply when a contact texts STOP/UNSUBSCRIBE. Leave blank to send no auto-reply (not recommended for TCPA compliance).
fields.label: Opt-Out Confirmation Message
